rendered: Films of different thickness were tested electrochemically: the thinner film is ∼40 nm[1] and the thicker film is ∼80 nm[2]. The thicker film was deposited with 1000[3] ALD cycles, as stated in the Raman figure caption. The thinner film corresponds to 500[4] ALD cycles in the XRD panel of Fig. 1[5], where that film is labelled as about 40 nm[6]. The potential shifts did not differ meaningfully: the text reports potential shifts of ∼40 mV[7] for both films, and similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[8] for the ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm V2O5 films.
